I’m Gaurav, a project and marketing professional moving deeper into product management. My work spans cross-functional delivery, digital workflows and business strategy. Here, I bring that experience into AI prototypes, product discovery and growth case studies.

I’m interested in the decisions behind the interface: which problem deserves attention, what evidence changes the direction, and what we should test before scaling. These projects show how I work through those questions.
